subject: Sapphire security intake: vendor questionnaire and IR/BCP deliverables
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@sapphirehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo security follow-up & next steps

Hi Sarah — great demo today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum on the security checklist: 

- Ask list from your side: completed vendor security questionnaire, SOC 2 Type II report (redacted if needed), clarification on HIPAA scope (covered entity vs. business associate), and any internal incident response / notification expectations.
- From our side: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report, an excerpt of our incident response playbook, and a high-level BCP/DR summary (RTOs/RPOs). We generally share artifacts via a secure upload link or SFTP presigned URLs — happy to follow your preferred secure channel.
- Timeline proposal: please send the vendor questionnaire within 3 business days; we aim to provide the requested artifacts within 48–72 hours of receiving the questionnaire and any details on scope (PHI involved, data residency).

Can you confirm:
1) Who should we send the artifacts to on your side (security contact + procurement/legal)?
2) Does Sapphire require a breach notification commitment window (e.g., 72 hours) or are there internal escalation rules we should be aware of (HIPAA workflows)?

I’ve looped Marissa (security lead) and Rishi (account lead) to coordinate. Next step from me: once we receive the questionnaire, we’ll prepare a redacted SOC 2 package and an IR timeline template you can use in your vendor risk process.

Thanks — Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@sapphirehealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sapphire Health Security <security@sapphirehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo security follow-up & next steps

Hi Aditya — thanks for the recap. We run a standard vendor intake here and I’ve attached the vendor_security_questionnaire_v1.xlsx for your team. A few notes from our side:

- We are HIPAA-covered (we process PHI for certain product modules). Please indicate whether Redwood will be a Business Associate or if there are scoped exclusions.
- Regarding SOC 2, we need the most recent Type II report (redacted is fine). We also ask for a short summary of any open corrective actions from the last audit.
- For incident response, our procurement/legal posture requires: confirmation of notification timelines, a point of contact (phone + email) for incident escalation, and confirmation that you will provide forensic evidence and a timeline for containment/remediation in the event of confirmed data exposure.
- Preferred transfer method: encrypted upload to vendor intake portal (we can accept presigned S3 links or secure Box folder). Please do not send reports as unencrypted email attachments.

Can you confirm you can complete the questionnaire and provide the artifacts by EOD Wednesday (2026-06-02)? If not, give us an expected delivery window.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lewis
Director, Vendor Risk & Compliance | Sapphire Health
sarah.lewis@sapphirehealth.com
(phone 612-555-1104)

Attachment: vendor_security_questionnaire_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 63KB)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@sapphirehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 31 May 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo security follow-up & next steps (internal coord)

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding Sarah’s questionnaire request. Action items I propose: 

- Marissa: please assemble the redacted SOC 2 Type II report, a one-page summary of any open action items from the 2025 audit, and the SOC scoping statement we used for the audit (to confirm PHI scope). Target: deliver to me by Monday EOD (2026-06-01) so we can upload securely.
- Rishi: please draft the IR notification timeline we can share with Sapphire. Include the following high-level commitments: detection acknowledgement window, investigation ETA, customer notification target, and sample evidence types we can provide (logs, timelines, forensic outputs). Also pull or summarize our BCP/DR RTO/RPO table and a short runbook excerpt. Target: have an initial draft by Monday morning so Marissa and I can review.
- Aditya (me): I’ll coordinate secure upload — preferring to create a presigned S3 folder (encrypted) and send the link to Sarah’s vendor intake portal address once you confirm readiness.

Notes: Sarah emphasized HIPAA coverage — flag any gaps if our SOC scope didn’t include PHI. If we need to treat this as a potential BA arrangement, we may need legal to review.

Thanks — Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@sapphirehealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo security follow-up & next steps

Hi Sarah — thanks for the questionnaire. Attached are the artifacts we can share now (redacted where appropriate):

- SOC2_Type_II_2025_redacted.pdf (redacted audit report; confidential)
- IR_playbook_excerpt.pdf (high-level incident response playbook excerpt; redacted operational details)
- BCP_summary.xlsx (short summary of RTOs/RPOs by critical service)
- vendor_response_matrix.xlsx (our responses mapped to your questionnaire for quick review)

High-level breach notification and IR timeline (illustrative):
- Detection & Triage: initial detection acknowledged within 1 hour of alert (24/7 monitoring in place).
- Triage & Containment: preliminary investigation and containment actions initiated within 4 hours of confirmation.
- Impact Assessment: targeted 24–72 hours for a preliminary impact assessment depending on scope.
- Customer Notification: for incidents impacting customer data we aim to notify affected customers within 48 hours of confirmed unauthorized access; where applicable we will follow statutory timelines (e.g., GDPR 72-hour filing to supervisory authority). For HIPAA-related exposures, we will work with the covered entity to meet breach notification obligations under the HIPAA Breach Rule.
- Evidence & Forensics: we will provide forensic timelines, relevant logs, and remediation actions as part of the post-incident package; exact artifacts will depend on the nature of the event but typically include system logs, change history, and a chronology of actions taken.

Secure transfer: we will upload the artifacts to a presigned, encrypted S3 folder and share the secure link via the vendor intake portal you referenced. If Sapphire prefers Box/SharePoint, let us know and we will use that channel instead.

Next steps: 
1) Please confirm the secure upload location (portal URL or acceptance of presigned S3).
2) Tell us which legal/procurement contacts to include so we can copy them on the artifact upload.
3) Let us know any questionnaire items you want us to prioritize in the vendor_response_matrix.

If you want a short walkthrough of the attached IR playbook excerpt I can schedule 20 minutes this week with Rishi.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
--
Attachments: SOC2_Type_II_2025_redacted.pdf (PDF, 520KB); IR_playbook_excerpt.pdf (PDF, 210KB); BCP_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet, 45KB); vendor_response_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)
